\section[\texorpdfstring{\ta{கால} \ta{அட்டவணை} (kāla aṭṭavaṇai)}{கால அட்டவணை (kāla aṭṭavaṇai)}]{\ta{கால} \ta{அட்டவணை} (kāla aṭṭavaṇai) — a timetable}

\label{lesson:TA-C160-kala-attavanai}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Tamil for to decide, then the Tamil for to expect.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ta{கால} \ta{அட்டவணை}}
\textbf{\ta{கால} \ta{அட்டவணை}} — \emph{kāla aṭṭavaṇai} — \textquotedblleft{}a timetable\textquotedblright{}.

\emph{Read it:} the board — \textbf{\ta{பேருந்து} \ta{புறப்படும்} \ta{நேரம்}: \ta{காலை} \ta{எட்டு} \ta{மணி}} — \emph{pēruntu puṟappaṭum nēram: kālai eṭṭu maṇi} — \textquotedblleft{}Bus departure time: 8 a.m.\textquotedblright{}

The bus leaves at eight, so be there before eight.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for this chapter.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{kāla aṭṭavaṇai}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{kāla aṭṭavaṇai}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{kāla aṭṭavaṇai}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Tamil for to decide, then the Tamil for to expect, then say \emph{kāla aṭṭavaṇai} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ta{கால} \ta{அட்டவணை} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A timetable\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\ta{அறிவிப்பு} (aṟivippu)}{அறிவிப்பு (aṟivippu)}]{\ta{அறிவிப்பு} (aṟivippu) — a notice, an announcement}

\label{lesson:TA-C160-arivippu}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Tamil for to expect, then the Tamil for a timetable.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ta{அறிவிப்பு}}
\textbf{\ta{அறிவிப்பு}} — \emph{aṟivippu} — \textquotedblleft{}a notice, an announcement\textquotedblright{}.

\emph{Read it:} the notice — \textbf{\ta{ஞாயிறுதோறும்} \ta{கடை} \ta{விடுமுறை}} — \emph{ñāyiṟutōṟum kaṭai viṭumuṟai} — \textquotedblleft{}Shop closed every Sunday.\textquotedblright{}

Come on another day.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for this chapter.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{aṟivippu}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{aṟivippu}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{aṟivippu}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Tamil for to expect, then the Tamil for a timetable, then say \emph{aṟivippu} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ta{அறிவிப்பு} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A notice, an announcement\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\ta{வாடகை} (vāṭakai)}{வாடகை (vāṭakai)}]{\ta{வாடகை} (vāṭakai) — rent; a fare}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\ta{விளம்பரம்} (viḷamparam)}{விளம்பரம் (viḷamparam)}]{\ta{விளம்பரம்} (viḷamparam) — an advert}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\ta{ரசீது} (racītu)}{ரசீது (racītu)}]{\ta{ரசீது} (racītu) — a receipt}

\label{lesson:TA-C160-racitu}



\begin{quote}

\section[(dialogue)]{Looking back — a first pass}

\label{lesson:TA-R160-first-pass-looking-back}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for an advert and a receipt.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} recently, already, last, once, to spend
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Recently? (\textbf{\ta{சமீபத்தில்}}, \emph{camīpattil}.) Already? (\textbf{\ta{ஏற்கனவே}}, \emph{ēṟkaṉavē}.) Last? (\textbf{\ta{போன}}, \emph{pōṉa}.) Once? (\textbf{\ta{ஒரு} \ta{காலத்தில்}}, \emph{oru kālattil}.) To spend? (\textbf{\ta{கழி}}, \emph{kaḻi}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Looking ahead and reading signs — a second pass}

\label{lesson:TA-R160-second-pass-looking-ahead-and-reading-signs}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for next and from now on.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item next, from now on, a plan, to decide, to expect
  \item a timetable, a notice, rent; a fare, an advert, a receipt
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Next? (\textbf{\ta{அடுத்த}}, \emph{aṭutta}.) From now on? (\textbf{\ta{இனிமேல்}}, \emph{iṉimēl}.) A plan? (\textbf{\ta{திட்டம்}}, \emph{tiṭṭam}.) To decide? (\textbf{\ta{முடிவு} \ta{செய்}}, \emph{muṭivu cey}.) To expect? (\textbf{\ta{எதிர்பார்}}, \emph{etirpār}.) A timetable? (\textbf{\ta{கால} \ta{அட்டவணை}}, \emph{kāla aṭṭavaṇai}.) A notice? (\textbf{\ta{அறிவிப்பு}}, \emph{aṟivippu}.) Rent; a fare? (\textbf{\ta{வாடகை}}, \emph{vāṭakai}.) An advert? (\textbf{\ta{விளம்பரம்}}, \emph{viḷamparam}.) A receipt? (\textbf{\ta{ரசீது}}, \emph{racītu}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
